authentication: formerly X-Api-Key; no working host responds now
cost_notes: Not applicable - the endpoint no longer exists. The replacement (uspto_open_data_portal) is free with a key.
known_limitations: PROBED 2026-11-09: the documented host search.patentsview.org does NOT resolve in DNS (NXDOMAIN from the Windows resolver and from 8.8.8.8). Both the /api/v1/patent/ and /docs/ calls failed with 'getaddrinfo failed'.
https://api.patentsview.org/patents/query returns HTTP 200 but an HTML single-page-app shell, not JSON: the retired API host now serves the website.

https://patentsview.org/apis/api-endpoints returns the same 20,666-byte shell, whose meta description reads 'The Open Data Portal (ODP) is USPTO's data platform ... for free' - the surface has been folded into uspto_open_data_portal.
Because the host is gone, the previously documented 'X-Api-Key required' state could not be re-verified; what is verified is that no PatentsView record can be fetched at all.
Do not count this source and uspto_open_data_portal as two independent patent authorities - that would double-count one upstream.
licence: US government work (formerly public domain); current terms live on the ODP, not here
research_value: Recorded here so the register does not pretend a dead P0 source is alive, and so no future analysis adds PatentsView as if it were independent evidence from USPTO. Its historical value (assignee_id/inventor_id disambiguation) is now only obtainable through the keyed ODP API.
source_name: PatentsView search API (retired / folded into USPTO ODP)
timestamp_fields: patent_date = GRANT date (the historical v1 API exposed no pre-grant publication date) -> at best a late public-visibility clock
NO pre-grant publication date existed even when the API worked
